tree.description: The skill tree definition. The engine reads only this namespace.

formatVersion.description: File format version (semver). Used for future migrations.

src.description: URL, path or asset id of the background image.

contrast.description: Contrast treatment applied by the consumer.

desaturate.description: Desaturation treatment applied by the consumer.

locked.description: If true, consumers must not move or replace this background.

background.description: Reference to a background image plus its visual treatment.

minX.description: Left edge of the coordinate space.

minY.description: Top edge of the coordinate space.

maxX.description: Right edge of the coordinate space.

maxY.description: Bottom edge of the coordinate space.

coordinateBounds.description: Fixed coordinate space for the canvas (world box).

thumbnail.description: PNG/SVG capture as base64 data URI or URL (optional).

imports.description: Other referenced documents (reserved for future composition).

nodeFills.description: Node body fill per visual state (CSS color strings). Partial: missing states fall back to the base theme.

textColor.description: Color for node labels, progress text, icons and region labels. Omit for an automatic legible default.

background.description: Canvas color. Applied as the inline background of the <svg> and used by the standalone export. Omit to let the consumer decide (editor chrome, or the CLI --dark flag).

tag.description: Nodes whose NodeDef.tags include this tag belong to the region.

color.description: CSS color string; the renderer applies it at low opacity.

items.description: Background tint for one region (membership is by node tag).

regions.description: Region tints. Region membership is by node tag.

nodeRings.description: Node ring (outline) color per visual state — the sibling of nodeFills, which paints the body. Partial: missing states fall back to the base theme.

color.description: Base edge line color (CSS color string).

active.description: Color for lit edges (those leaving an unlocked/maxed node). Falls back to color.

edges.description: Edge colors. Omit to fall back to the base.

fontFamily.description: Full CSS font stack, generic fallback included (e.g. 'Cinzel, serif').

typography.description: Label typography. Omit to fall back to the base.

iconColor.description: Node icon color. Falls back to textColor when omitted.

regionShape.description: Region tint shape: 'box' (default) or 'hull' (smoothed blob around the nodes).

regionLabel.description: Where the region name goes: 'top' (default) or 'center' (large, in the region color, behind the nodes).

labelMinRadius.description: Minimum node radius that earns a label; smaller nodes render icon only. Enables atlas density.

ornateMinRadius.description: Minimum node radius that earns an ornate outer frame (a second concentric ring).

sizes.description: Render sizes. Omit to fall back to the base.

radius.description: Glow blur radius in layout units. 0 or omitted means no glow at all.

items.description: Visual node state that a theme can fill.

states.description: Visual states that glow. Defaults to unlockable/unlocked/maxed.

edges.description: Whether lit edges glow too. Default false.

glow.description: Glow effect. Omit for no glow at all.

preset.description: Id of the preset this theme started from (informative, for UIs).

theme.description: Document theme: presentation layer, separate from the TreeDef.

editor.description: Editor-level metadata (background, coordinate bounds, theme…). Engines ignore this namespace; editors read it. Unknown keys are preserved (forward compatibility).
